def transform(grid):

    Marks sit at line intersections. Output = block grid cropped to the
    bounding box of blocks whose 4 corner intersections all carry the same
    mark color; those blocks get that color, others keep the fill."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    cnt = Counter(c for r in grid for c in r)

    line = cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    ok = {line}
    for r in grid:
        for c in r:
            if c not in (fill, line):
                ok.add(c)
    hl = [i for i in range(H) if all(c in ok for c in grid[i])]
    vl = [j for j in range(W) if all(grid[i][j] in ok for i in range(H))]
    M = [[grid[i][j] for j in vl] for i in hl]
    n, m = len(hl) - 1, len(vl) - 1
    out = [[fill] * m for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            cs = (M[r][c], M[r][c + 1], M[r + 1][c], M[r + 1][c + 1])
            if len(set(cs)) == 1 and cs[0] != line:
                out[r][c] = cs[0]
